sound_enabled.label: Alarm sound
sound_enabled.description: Enable or disable alarm playback. The built-in tone uses Noctalia audio; custom audio uses the selected external player.

custom_sound.label: Custom alarm sound
custom_sound.description: Choose one audio file for all alarms. Leave empty to use the built-in tone. Supported: WAV, FLAC, Ogg, Opus, MP3, AIFF.
